outcome.technical: audit-lookup.py: added _suite_runner (an interpreter-led simple command running a non-suite script or a -m module, every path behind it a suite, read with _manifest_phases' _is_script_runner/shell_word_path/is_suite_path), _plan_commands + suite_taking_runners (runners the plan spells handed a suite path in any buildCommands value or task gate entry: the basis that a runner takes suite paths, not a list of program names), _given_suites (suites in place of the step's own path args, else appended), _runs_whole_tree (a listed whole run counts as running the suites only for a known runner), suite_coverage (derived command from the first declared simple step with a known runner, preamble re-applied through _evio.resolved_commands; otherwise one line per suite: '<suite>: no command to run it is given - <reason>', the reason naming no gate / no single known runner / compound). compose_writer_prompt collects listed raw commands in its loop, appends derived lines with GIVEN_SUITES_NOTE and the reason lines after the run list; docstring says the runner answer reaches past the task to the plan.
